drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Transthoracic echo: LVEF 59%, grade I diastolic dysfunction

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 82-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.85, bnp 233, creatinine 0.83, hemoglobin 12.1, platelets 319, sodium 141, wbc 8.8; vitals dbp 72-76, heart_rate 79-84, map 91-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 126-130, spo2 96-97, temp 37.1-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 20 mg PO daily (home med); Transthoracic echo: LVEF 59%, grade I diastolic dysfunction
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. No acute heart failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.8, hemoglobin 12.1, platelets 313, sodium 140, wbc 8.7; vitals dbp 71-75, heart_rate 79-84, map 90-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 125-131, spo2 96-97, temp 37-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 20 mg PO daily (home med)
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. No acute heart failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 82-year-old female, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. No acute heart failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
